scope: Independent resource-array identity and browser-buffer retention/sharing observations, with separately attributed isolated startup/decode profiles. No manufacturing array or rendered buffer content was simplified. Integration and release status are recorded separately.

manufacturing_identity.comparison: Decoded array bytes versus pre-optimization main SHA256 values, for vertices, triangle indices and face normals of every prepared piece.
manufacturing_identity.decoder_method: Independent byte-plane reconstruction through per-axis uint32 shifts/OR, XOR prefix, int64 integer prefix and float32 component translation. Compares all decoded bytes with pre-optimization main array SHA256; no product loader, generator or model simplification.

resource_storage.right_latch: Shares the left resource only after exact float32 translation, index and normal proofs; final right-vertex SHA256 remains the pre-optimization value.

browser_buffer_audit.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (0x00003E98) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
browser_buffer_audit.sequence: Rugged, Open bin, Rugged, Open bin, Rugged, Open bin, Rugged. Wire toggled on and off after first and final Rugged loads. This is not three complete eight-card tours.
browser_buffer_audit.instrumentation: Read-only mesh statistics and GL buffer upload/bind/delete observations; hashing promises complete before GC. Data are not simplified or regenerated for the browser.
browser_buffer_audit.gpu_byte_scope: Unique bytes allocated through WebGL bufferData for the scene, excluding the 744-byte bed buffer. This is not driver residency, physical GPU memory, browser RSS, or total application memory.
browser_buffer_audit.cpu_byte_scope: Unique retained position/index ArrayBuffers in the scene, excluding transient arrays, transport, engine and browser overhead.
browser_buffer_audit.heap_scope: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize after explicit GC; not whole-process RSS.

representative_actual_bound_buffers.comparison_scope: Every corresponding phase was compared with the baseline. These representative hashes avoid repeating identical content for all alternations.

limitations: Byte-array and GL-input equality do not certify physical printing, fit force, fatigue, strength or support-free manufacturing.
No sustained animation FPS or frame-time budget is measured here.
Three alternations are a bounded regression check, not a long-duration memory-leak proof.
Selection benchmarks use sequential completed requests; an active custom extraction is not preempted by the current coalescing worker.
Transport still sends the full base64 vertex/index preview payload. Removing retained strings does not remove its transient parsing or delivery cost.
Source hashes identify this snapshot. Later source changes require revalidation.

startup_comparison.scope: Three isolated fresh Python processes per bundle/mode; NumPy import included in bundle_import, not artificially preimported. No preview/CAD/native Orca/filesystem cache flush. Python bytecode writing disabled.
startup_comparison.measurement_author: Separate profiling agent; samples and medians independently checked for this record.
startup_comparison.interpretation: Median import decreased from 3856.5 to 1990.7 ms in fresh isolated processes with warm filesystem cache. The final import range was 1961.2 to 2084.0 ms; no universal sub-two-second startup bound is established.

actual_product_loader.measurement: Actual new product loader, fresh isolated process per sample; NumPy import excluded; loader validation included; independent approved V/T/N verification outside timing; filesystem cache warm. Source module form, not standalone base64/startup/UI/Orca latency.
actual_product_loader.measurement_author: Separate profiling agent; current source hashes checked for this record.

exploratory_codec_measurements.measurement: Fresh isolated Python subprocess per sample; NumPy import excluded; read/decode/blob+V/T/N hash validation/finite/range checks included; filesystem cache warm. Prototype decoder microbenchmark, not UI/Orca latency.
exploratory_codec_measurements.context: These 33 prototype-decoder samples include unsuccessful candidate strategies. They are not native/UI timings and are not equivalent to the actual product-loader implementation.

codec_tradeoffs.comparability: Illustrative observations from separate prototype-baseline and actual-product-loader runs. They are not a strict paired old-product/new-product end-to-end benchmark. NumPy import is outside both timed decode regions.

full_rugged.interpretation: Approximately stable in these observations; package size/startup reduction is not a claim that every decode becomes faster or has a smaller transient memory peak.

outside_scope: Native Orca startup, simultaneous Page/Dock memory and native interaction latency.

Latency while a previous custom extraction or export is still active.
